features.name: Deterministic Policy Gateway
features.description: P1-P6 rules: only authorizes when all checks pass. AI only recommends.

features.name: Raw Evidence Archive (Phase B)
features.description: 4KB-capped append-only archive with SHA256 checksums and retention cleanup.

features.name: Risk Scoring Engine (Phase C)
features.description: Weighted multi-signal risk engine, session hijack, password spray, mass delete detectors.

features.name: WAF/ModSecurity Log Adapter (Phase D)
features.description: Maps ModSecurity JSON audit entries to web_request events. SAMPLE-BASED.

features.name: Trace ID Correlation (Phase E)
features.description: Links events by trace_id/request_id or user/session/time window.

features.name: Security Posture Assessment (Phase F)
features.description: HTTPS/HSTS, cookie flags, security headers, MFA, RDP, backup, KEV check. Localhost only.

features.name: Validation Matrix (Phase G)
features.description: 6 benign / 8 attack scenarios; TP/FP/TN/FN, precision, recall.

features.name: Sample-Based Connectors (Phase I)
features.description: BigQuery audit log and Sysmon event mappers. SAMPLE-BASED, not live.

features.name: Phishing Scoring
features.description: Deterministic rule-based phishing scorer with verdict red/amber/green.

features.name: Contract Extensions (Phase A)
features.description: block_ip action, network_connection event, optional trace/session fields, affected_ips.
